title: ADR-015: Move the ledger outbox relay to managed change data capture
author: omar
text:
# ADR-015: Move the ledger outbox relay to managed change data capture

- Status: Accepted
- Decided by: Omar
- Date: 2026-10-16
- Affected services: ledger-service
- Supersedes: ADR-012

## Context

ADR-012 introduced a Postgres transactional outbox for ledger events with a hand-written relay that polls the outbox table. In the first two weeks the relay needed two hotfixes (ordering after a failover, and a stuck batch when a row exceeded the message size limit), and LED-44 showed we would also have to build backlog alerting and retention ourselves.

## Decision

We keep the outbox table, but replace the hand-written relay with a managed change data capture connector that reads the outbox from the Postgres write-ahead log and publishes to the existing ledger-events topic. The ledger service write path does not change.

## Consequences

- Ordering and failover handling come from the connector instead of our own code.
- Backlog and lag metrics come from the connector, which replaces most of LED-44.
- Requires logical replication on the ledger database and a replication slot that must be monitored for growth.
